brabants.name: Brabants
brabants.about: The soft, warm Dutch of North Brabant: gij and ge for you, a lot of gezelligheid, 'houdoe' for goodbye and a famously laid-back attitude.

greet: Hi! Are you at ASML too?
Morning! Did the bus to the High Tech Campus show up?
Hello! Coming to the meetup at Strijp-S?
Hi there, first week at TU/e?
reply: All good, thanks, just finished a long shift in the cleanroom.
Great, the locals are so friendly here.
Fine thanks, bit tired from cycling in the wind.
Not bad at all, I love how small this city is.
sunny: Sun's out, everyone will be on the Stratumseind terraces.
Perfect day for a ride through the Genneper Parken.
Lovely, let's eat outside at the Markt.
Sunny, the lake at the Karpendonkse Plas will be busy.
Gorgeous day, shame I'm in meetings till five.
rain: Raining again, glad the campus has covered walkways.
Wet and windy, the classic commute.
Bring a rain jacket, it's coming down.
Grey day, perfect for working from home.
Pouring, I'm taking the bus today.
bye: Houdoe! I learned that one this week.
Take care, see you at the borrel!
busy: Sorry, call with the Veldhoven team in five!
Running to catch my train to Amsterdam, talk soon!
Late for a lab session, see you!
Can't stop, see you at lunch?

sunny: Mooi weer, fietsen naar de Genneper Parken?
rain: Het plenst, ik pak de bus.
busy: Ik heb zo een meeting, doei!
Mijn trein gaat zo, tot later!

sunny: Mooi weer, efkes een terraske pakken?
Zonneke erbij, wat wilde nog meer?
Mooi weer om te fietsen, jong.
rain: Regen, dan blijven we lekker binnen.
busy: Ik ben te laat, sorry hè!

touts: De trein naar Amsterdam Centraal vertrekt van spoor 2.
hawkers: Brabant sausage bread, warm from the oven!
Three kilos of apples, two euros!
Battered fish bites, nice and hot!
Doughnut balls, freshly fried! (around New Year)
small_talk: Glow festival is coming, the centre will be packed.
The bus to the High Tech Campus was full of ASML badges again.
Stratumseind on a Thursday is students everywhere.
Ryanair to Porto from Eindhoven Airport, can't beat it.
Did you see PSV on Sunday? The whole city was out.
Dutch Design Week is on, Strijp-S is full of installations.
The Evoluon still looks like a spaceship landed.
Carnival here and the city turns into Lampegat for a week.
Half my team commutes to Veldhoven by bike.
